# Ultra-Water (Humpalumps) — attribution

This directory vendors source from **[Ultra-Water / Gelatin Water](https://gelatin.games/ultrawater)** by **Humpalumps**, used for ocean FFT water, island terrain, sky/atmosphere, and the multi-pass render pipeline in the water-plant Lagoon scene.

- Upstream: https://github.com/ (see https://gelatin.games/ultrawater)
- License: MIT — see `LICENSE` in this folder (Copyright (c) 2026 Humpalumps)
- Water-plant app keeps its own Chinese HUD and plant models; open ocean + land come from these modules.

The MIT license text must be retained with redistributions of these files.
